GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND o.created_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
